text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing the way we live and work. Many companies now use AI to automate simple tasks, from answering customer questions to sorting emails. This process, known as automation, allows businesses to become more efficient because computers can process huge amounts of data much faster than people. An algorithm is a set of instructions that tells a device what to do, and modern algorithms can even predict what customers want before they ask. As a result, some workers fear that machines will replace their jobs. However, most experts believe AI will change the workforce rather than destroy it completely. Although automation brings clear benefits, such as fewer mistakes and lower costs, it also creates a threat to people whose jobs are repetitive. To stay employed, workers need new skills that machines do not have, such as creativity and communication. Companies that invest in innovation and regularly update their systems tend to grow faster. If we rely on AI wisely, it can make accurate decisions and free people to do more interesting work.
